messages:
Rae N.: Scheduled vendor assessment 2026-08-03 09:00-12:00 PDT. Need quick plan: ephemeral RBAC, KMS grant pattern, readroom presigns, audit snapshot, and two retest slots. Who takes what?

Ibrahim A.: I can own RBAC + revoke tooling. Plan: create role pt_assessor_temp with sts:AssumeRole from vendor account, max session 60m, no console. Will add `revoke-role.sh` to run on anomaly.

Kara L.: I'll handle KMS and evidence flow. Prefer encrypt-only grants for uploads, avoid Decrypt. If vendor needs Decrypt for repro, require signed approval and rotate key after. Example create-grant for upload: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence --grantee-principal <GRANTEE_ARN> --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey --name "pt-upload-<id>"`

Rae N.: Reading room rules: presigned GET TTL 72h, presigned PUT TTL 24h for SBOMs only. No console perms. Live logs via cross-account CloudWatch role with 1h sessions.

Ibrahim A.: IAM policy stub for assessor-role: allow s3:GetObject on readroom/* and s3:PutObject on uploads/*, explicitly deny s3:DeleteObject. Will add to tracker.

sec-bot: Preflight reminder created: "PT preflight ENG-910" scheduled 2026-08-02 16:00 PDT.

Kara L.: Alerts: monitor CloudTrail KMS Decrypt and S3 DeleteObject attempts. PagerDuty if Decrypt > baseline*2 in 10m.

Rae N.: Proposed retest slots: 2026-08-06 14:00-16:00 UTC and 2026-08-07 09:00-11:00 UTC. Kara + Ibrahim can staff?

Ibrahim A.: I can cover Aug 7. Will script retire-grant and revoke role at session end.

Kara L.: I'll cover Aug 6 and validate evidence packaging. Post-engagement: retire grants, revoke roles, export trail snapshot, rotate key if Decrypt occurred, and attach manifest to the tracker.

Rae N.: Great. Action items: Ibrahim = IAM + revoke scripts; Kara = KMS grants + alerts; Rae = calendar + tracker entries. Reconvene at preflight. Thanks.
